title: 第七百九十章 夜寺问剑 瓦剌藏谋第七百八十九章 妖蝶引路 仙人醉月
content_zh:
花百漾神色僵滞一瞬，方才淡淡应声道：“不错。异蝶术越是趋近大成，体内蛰伏的寒毒便越容易被引动爆发！”
虫小蝶沉默片刻，视线下移，落在花百漾披风遮掩的腰侧。
披风之下隐隐凸起一道狭长轮廓，分明是一柄长剑的剑刃。
“你莫不是强行催动异蝶术，试图驾驭蝶刃神兵？”
花百漾并未作答，只是再次将酒坛凑到唇边，闷头又灌下一大口烈酒！
二人并肩静坐于檐角，望着月下荒芜古寺。
周遭只剩晚风轻响，长久陷入沉默。
许久，花百漾才缓缓开口，语气裹着一丝苦涩自嘲道：“自从得到蝶刃，我日夜不休钻研剑中奥义。无数次强行催动异蝶术，一心想要彻底收服这柄神兵，可始终参不透内里法门！”
他垂眸看向自己布满毒疮的手臂，一声长叹，满心疲惫道：“我满身溃烂毒疮，全是异蝶术引动寒毒留下的祸患。若不是执念‘蝶刃’，我平日修炼异蝶术，尚能以自身真气循序渐进泄去体内寒毒。也不至于淤积于五脏六腑，落得这般模样！我越是一心想要征服蝶刃，便越频繁强行运功，寒毒日积月累，终究彻底爆发！”
“如此说来，‘蝶刃’反倒成了困住你的执念！你的身心尽数被这一柄神兵禁锢束缚！”
虫小蝶望着身旁这位威震武林的蝶门宗主，见他一身盖世武功，却被一柄剑困住迷茫。
心底不由生出几分唏嘘惋惜，同为修习蝶系武学，他最懂这种求而不得的煎熬。
花百漾忽然直起身，身形踉跄往前半步。
周身气息骤然冷冽，转头沉声唤道：“虫小蝶！”
虫小蝶眼底带着几分茫然，静静望向他。
“你千不该万不该插手明廷宫变一事，更不该在万千文武、两军将士面前，施展出那套气象万千、近乎毁天灭地的蝶刃剑招！”
花百漾站起身，一双眼眸覆上寒冰。
死死锁定虫小蝶，语气冷硬刺骨！
虫小蝶心头恍然，轻轻点头道：“原来如此，是那一战的剑招，让你确认我习得了蝶刃剑法！”
“我数十次强行催动蝶刃无果。苦思良久，翻阅各方探子传回的情报，才终于寻到我想要的答案！”

花百漾朝虫小蝶伸出手掌，语气带着不容置喙的强势，“拿来吧！”
虫小蝶原地不动，双臂叠于胸前。
凝神静气注视着他，没有半分退让！
“都怪你插手平叛暴乱。若是你收敛自身行迹，从不显露蝶刃剑法。我多半不会怀疑到你的头上！”
花百漾冷笑一声，语气裹挟着自负，“如今就算你不愿交出，也由不得你！况且蝶刃剑法本就出自我蝶门宗。今日取回，不过是物归原主！”
话音刚落，古寺周遭的草丛、断墙之后忽然传来细碎窸窸窣窣的动静！
虽刻意压低声响，却半点逃不过虫小蝶常年习武打磨的敏锐双耳。
虫小蝶轻轻摇头，唇角勾起一抹淡然笑意道：“看来花宗主今日是有备而来。只不过……”
“只不过什么？”
花百漾眉峰一挑，追问出声。
content_en:
Hua Baiyang's expression froze for a moment, and then he responded calmly: "That's right. The closer the Abnormal Butterfly Technique is to reaching perfection, the easier it will be for the dormant cold poison in the body to be triggered to explode!"
Chong Xiaodie was silent for a moment, then her eyes moved down and landed on the waist covered by Hua Baiyang's cloak.
Under the cloak, a long and narrow outline faintly protruded, which was clearly the blade of a long sword.
"Did you forcefully activate the Butterfly Technique and try to control the Butterfly Blade Divine Weapon?"
Hua Baiyang didn't answer, but brought the wine jar to her lips again, and drank another large gulp of strong wine!
The two of them sat quietly side by side on the eaves corner, looking at the deserted ancient temple under the moonlight.
There was only the gentle sound of the evening breeze, and there was silence for a long time.
After a long time, Hua Baiyang spoke slowly, with a hint of bitter self-mockery in her tone: "Since I got the butterfly blade, I have been studying the secrets of the sword day and night. I have forced the butterfly technique countless times, and I want to completely conquer this magic weapon, but I still can't figure out the inner secret!"
He lowered his eyes and looked at his arms covered with poisonous sores, let out a long sigh, and said with a heart full of exhaustion: "My whole body is covered with festering poisonous sores, all caused by the cold poison caused by the Alien Butterfly Technique. If I hadn't been obsessed with the 'Butterfly Blade', I would still be able to practice the Alien Butterfly Technique on weekdays. I can use my own Qi to gradually release the cold poison from my internal organs, so that it won’t end up like this! The more I want to conquer the Butterfly Blade, the more frequently I force the cold poison to accumulate, and it will finally break out!”
"In this case, the 'Butterfly Blade' has become an obsession that traps you! Your body and mind are completely restrained and restrained by this magical weapon!"
Chong Xiaodie looked at the powerful leader of the Butterfly Sect next to him, and saw that he was a man of unparalleled martial arts, but he was trapped and confused by a sword.
He couldn't help but feel a bit of regret in his heart. He was also practicing butterfly martial arts, and he knew best the suffering of not getting what he wanted.
Hua Baiyang suddenly straightened up and staggered half a step forward.
The aura around him suddenly became cold, and he turned around and called out in a deep voice: "Chong Xiaodie!"
Chong Xiaodie looked at him quietly with a bit of confusion in her eyes.
"You should never have interfered with the Ming Palace incident, and you should never have used that butterfly blade sword move that was so powerful that it almost destroyed the world in front of thousands of civil and military officers and soldiers!"
Hua Baiyang stood up, her eyes covered with ice.
Xiaodie, the dead-locked insect, spoke with a cold and harsh tone!
Chong Xiaodie suddenly felt enlightened and nodded slightly: "So, it was the sword moves from that battle that made you confirm that I have learned the butterfly blade sword technique!"
"I forced the butterfly blade dozens of times to no avail. After thinking hard for a long time and reading the information sent back by spies from all sides, I finally found the answer I wanted!"
Hua Baiyang stretched out her palm towards Chong Xiaodie and said with an undeniable force, "Bring it here!"
Chong Xiaodie stayed still, with her arms folded in front of her chest.
Watching him intently and calmly, without giving in at all!
"It's all your fault for interfering in suppressing the rebellion. If you had restrained your behavior and never showed off your butterfly sword skills, I probably wouldn't have suspected you!"
Hua Baiyang sneered, her tone full of pride, "Now even if you don't want to hand it over, you can't help it! Besides, the butterfly blade sword technique originally came from my butterfly sect. Taking it back today is just returning it to its original owner!"
As soon as he finished speaking, tiny rustling sounds suddenly came from behind the grass and broken walls around the ancient temple!
Although he deliberately lowered his voice, it could not escape Chong Xiaodie's sharp ears honed by years of martial arts practice.
Chong Xiaodie shook her head slightly, with a faint smile on her lips and said, "It seems that Sect Master Hua came prepared today. But..."
"Just what?"
Hua Baiyang raised her eyebrows and asked.
